independent_review: evidence_review: complete scoped controller/observer review; requested bounded streaming census and PCI device identity, both fixed and rechecked.
scope: CPU tests only. Target-only two/four stage controller; independent explicit run admission required. Legacy MTP templates not accepted. No clean-host installation/runtime or speed certification.
corrections: Explicit pinned external observer wrapper, no packaged credential path or privilege-policy mutation.
Streaming os.scandir with count/deadline bounds, no eager Path.iterdir/listdir inventory.
PCI vendor/device/subsystem/revision identities compared against independently admitted baseline.
Missing other-user FD permissions, PID identity race, new fault, changed resource/hardware or unknown observer fails closed.
Stage tracked immediately after Popen, cooperative stop once, no kill/reset/retry path.
Fault snapshot retained before validation; passive postflight retained after success or failure.
